title.instructions: Use a short task-shaped title, ideally 3-6 words. Name the subsystem when useful.

branchName.instructions: Use <type>/<scope>-<short-desc>. Allowed types: feat, fix, refactor, test, docs, chore. Lowercase and hyphens only after the slash.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits: <type>(<scope>): <concise description>. Do not mention AI or agents.

pullRequest.instructions: Write a concise PR with sections: Summary, Why, Testing, Safety impact, Follow-up. Explicitly state skipped hardware validation or unsupported device assumptions.
